translations.idiomatic: When he learned Han Shizhong would move his army from Chuzhou to Zhenjiang, he again laid out five points of concern.

sentences.zh: 王倫使北請和，次膺言：「宣和海上之約，靖康城下之盟，口血未乾，兵隨其後。

translations.literal: When Wang Lun went north to sue for peace, Ciying said: "The agreement at sea in the Xuanhe era, the covenant beneath the walls of Jingkang — the blood on their lips was not yet dry before troops followed.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Lun went north to sue for peace, Ciying said, "The agreement at sea in the Xuanhe era, the covenant beneath the walls of Jingkang — the blood on their lips was not yet dry before troops followed.

sentences.zh: 今日之事當識其詐。」

translations.literal: Today's affair calls for recognizing their deceit.
translations.idiomatic: Today's affair calls for recognizing their deceit."

sentences.zh: 時秦檜在政府，為其妻兄王仲薿敘兩官。

translations.literal: At the time Qin Hui was in the government and had arranged two rank appointments for his wife's elder brother Wang Zhongwei.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Qin Hui held office and had arranged two rank appointments for his wife's elder brother Wang Zhongwei.

sentences.zh: 次膺劾仲薿奴事朱勔，投拜金酋，罪在不赦。

translations.literal: Ciying impeached Zhongwei for serving as a slave to Zhu Mi and bowing to submit to the Jin chief — crimes beyond pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Ciying impeached Zhongwei for having served Zhu Mi as a slave and bowing to submit to the Jin chief — crimes beyond pardon.

sentences.zh: 又劾知撫州王㬇違法佃官田，不輸租。

translations.literal: He also impeached Prefect of Fuzhou Wang Kuan for illegally farming government fields and failing to pay rent.
translations.idiomatic: He also impeached the prefect of Fuzhou, Wang Kuan, for illegally farming government fields and failing to pay rent.

sentences.zh: 其父仲山，先知撫州，屈膝金人，㬇繼其後，何顏見吏民？

translations.literal: His father Zhongshan was earlier prefect of Fuzhou and bent knee to the Jin; Kuan succeeded him — with what face can he look upon officials and people?
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhongshan had earlier served as prefect of Fuzhou and bent knee to the Jin; Kuan succeeded him — with what face can he look upon officials and people?

sentences.zh: 㬇，檜之妻兄也。

translations.literal: Kuan was also Hui's wife's elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan, too, was Hui's wife's elder brother.

sentences.zh: 章留中。

translations.literal: The memorial was kept at court without action.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was held at court without action.

sentences.zh: 次膺再論之曰：「近臣奏二人，繼聞追寢除命，是皆檜容私營救，陛下曲從其欲，國之紀綱，臣之責任，一切廢格。

translations.literal: Ciying argued again: "A remonstrance official memorialized against two men, yet I soon heard the appointments revoked — all because Hui tolerated private rescue efforts and Your Majesty indulged his wishes. The state's discipline and a minister's responsibility have all been set aside.
translations.idiomatic: Ciying argued again, "A remonstrance official memorialized against two men, yet I soon heard the appointments revoked — all because Hui tolerated private rescue efforts and Your Majesty indulged his wishes. The state's discipline and a minister's responsibility have all been set aside.

sentences.zh: 借使貴連宮掖，親如肺附，寵任非宜，臣亦得論之，而大臣之姻婭，乃不得繩之耶？

translations.literal: Even if one were linked by rank to the palace inner quarters, close as lungs to the frame, and unfit for favor — a minister may still remonstrate. Yet a grand councilor's in-laws cannot be bound by law?
translations.idiomatic: Even if one were linked by rank to the palace inner quarters, close as lungs to the frame, and unfit for favor — a minister may still remonstrate. Yet a grand councilor's in-laws cannot be bound by law?

sentences.zh: 望陛下奮乾剛之威，戒蒙蔽之漸。」

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will summon the authority of Qian, and guard against the gradual onset of being misled.
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will summon the authority of Qian and guard against the gradual onset of being misled."

sentences.zh: 求去，除直秘閣、湖南提刑。

translations.literal: He requested dismissal and was appointed to the Imperial Archives and made judicial intendant of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to leave office and was appointed to the Imperial Archives and made judicial intendant of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 先是，湖南賊龍淵、李朝擁眾數萬，據衡之茶陵，檜匿不奏，乃以見闕處次膺。

translations.literal: Previously bandits Long Yuan and Li Chao in Hunan had gathered tens of thousands and held Chaling in Hengzhou. Hui concealed this and did not report it, and placed Ciying in the vacancy.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the Hunan bandits Long Yuan and Li Chao had gathered tens of thousands and held Chaling in Hengzhou. Hui concealed this and did not report it, and placed Ciying in the vacancy.

sentences.zh: 陛辭，上曰：「卿以將母為請，朕不得留。

translations.literal: At his farewell audience the emperor said: "You asked to go to care for your mother — I cannot keep you.
translations.idiomatic: At his farewell audience the emperor said, "You asked to go to care for your mother — I cannot keep you.

sentences.zh: 湖湘風物甚佳，且無盜賊，職名異恩，卒歲當召。」

translations.literal: The scenery of Hunan and Hubei is splendid, and there are no bandits. The post carries special favor; at year's end you will surely be recalled.
translations.idiomatic: The scenery of Hunan and Hubei is splendid, and there are no bandits. The post carries special favor; at year's end you will surely be recalled."

sentences.zh: 既抵長沙，賊勢方張，戍將抽回，始悟檜欲陷之。

translations.literal: When he reached Changsha, the bandits were at full strength and garrison troops had been withdrawn — only then did he understand that Hui meant to trap him.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Changsha, the bandits were at full strength and the garrison troops had been withdrawn — only then did he realize Hui meant to trap him.

sentences.zh: 即單車趨茶陵，擒賊驍將戮之，募賊黨毛義、龍麟等，齎榜諭以朝廷抽回戍將，務欲招安，宜亟降，待以不死。

translations.literal: Immediately he went alone by cart to Chaling, captured and executed a bandit champion, recruited bandit followers Mao Yi and Long Lin, and sent proclamations explaining that the court had withdrawn garrison troops intending to offer amnesty — they should surrender quickly and would be spared death.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately went alone by cart to Chaling, captured and executed a bandit champion, recruited the bandit followers Mao Yi and Long Lin, and sent proclamations explaining that the court had withdrawn garrison troops intending to offer amnesty — they should surrender quickly and would be spared death.

sentences.zh: 龍淵、李朝相繼降，仍請料精銳，可得禁旅萬餘。

translations.literal: Long Yuan and Li Chao surrendered in succession, yet still requested to assemble picked troops — more than ten thousand palace guards could be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Long Yuan and Li Chao surrendered in succession, yet still asked to assemble picked troops — more than ten thousand palace guards could be raised.

sentences.zh: 次鷹笑曰：「是皆吾民，正當棄兵甲，持鋤耰，趣令復業。」

translations.literal: Ciying laughed and said: "These are all our people — they should simply discard arms, take up hoes, and be urged to resume their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: Ciying laughed and said, "These are all our people — they should simply discard arms, take up hoes, and be urged to resume their livelihoods."

sentences.zh: 奏茶陵為軍。

translations.literal: He memorialized to make Chaling a military garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to establish Chaling as a military garrison.

sentences.zh: 金好成，赦書至衡陽，次膺極陳其詐，略曰：「臣昨在諫列，嘗數論金人變詐無常，願陛下為宗社生靈深慮。

translations.literal: When the Jin peace was concluded and an amnesty edict reached Hengyang, Ciying vigorously denounced its deceit, saying in summary: "When I was among the remonstrance officials I repeatedly argued that the Jin change tactics without constancy — I urge Your Majesty to deliberate deeply for the altars of state and the living people.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin peace was concluded and an amnesty edict reached Hengyang, Ciying vigorously denounced its deceit, saying in summary, "When I was among the remonstrance officials I repeatedly argued that the Jin change tactics without constancy — I urge Your Majesty to deliberate deeply for the altars of state and the living people.

sentences.zh: 近觀邸報，樞密院編修官胡銓妄議和好，歷詆大臣，除名遠竄。

translations.literal: Recently reading the court gazette, I see that Compilation Officer Hu Quan of the Bureau of Military Affairs rashly debated the peace, reviled successive ministers, was stripped of rank and banished far away.
translations.idiomatic: Recently reading the court gazette, I see that Compilation Officer Hu Quan of the Bureau of Military Affairs rashly debated the peace, reviled successive ministers, was stripped of rank and banished far away.

sentences.zh: 已而得銓書槁，乃知朝廷遽欲屈己稱藩，臣未知其可。

translations.literal: Having then obtained Quan's draft letter, I know the court suddenly wishes to humble itself and declare vassalage — I do not know whether this can be done.
translations.idiomatic: Having then obtained Quan's draft letter, I know the court suddenly wishes to humble itself and declare vassalage — I do not know whether this can be done.

sentences.zh: 大臣懷姦固位，不恤國計，媕婀趨和，謬以為便，臣不知天下之人以為便乎？

translations.literal: Grand ministers harbor treachery to hold their posts, heedless of state policy, fawning toward peace and wrongly deeming it convenient — I do not know whether people under heaven deem it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Grand ministers harbor treachery to hold their posts, heedless of state policy, fawning toward peace and wrongly deeming it convenient — I do not know whether people under heaven deem it convenient.

sentences.zh: 『父之讎不與共戴天，兄弟之讎不反兵』。

translations.literal: 'One does not live under the same heaven as the murderer of one's father; one does not turn home with weapons against the murderer of one's brother.'
translations.idiomatic: One does not live under the same heaven as the murderer of one's father; one does not turn home with weapons against the murderer of one's brother.'

sentences.zh: 棄讎釋怨，盡除前事，降萬乘之尊，以求說於敵，天下之人，果能遂亡怨痛以從陛下之志乎？」

translations.literal: Abandoning vengeance, releasing grievances, clearing away all prior affairs, lowering the dignity of the Son of Heaven to please the enemy — can people under heaven truly put aside hatred and pain to follow Your Majesty's wish?
translations.idiomatic: Abandoning vengeance, releasing grievances, clearing away all prior affairs, lowering the dignity of the Son of Heaven to please the enemy — can people under heaven truly put aside hatred and pain to follow Your Majesty's wish?"

sentences.zh: 書奏，不報。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted, but no response was given.

sentences.zh: 金陷三京。

translations.literal: The Jin captured the three capitals.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin took the three capitals.

sentences.zh: 次膺罷，奉祠。

translations.literal: Ciying was dismissed and granted a temple sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: Ciying was removed from office and granted a temple sinecure.

sentences.zh: 秦檜以其負重名，欲先移書，當稍收用，次膺笑而不答。

translations.literal: Qin Hui, because he carried great reputation, wished first to send a letter — surely he would be somewhat reemployed. Ciying smiled and did not reply.
translations.idiomatic: Because Ciying carried great reputation, Qin Hui wished first to send a letter — surely he would be somewhat reemployed. Ciying smiled and did not reply.

sentences.zh: 閱十六年，貧益甚，亡毫髮求於人。

translations.literal: Sixteen years passed; he grew ever poorer, not seeking the slightest thing from others.
translations.idiomatic: After sixteen years he grew ever poorer, never seeking the slightest thing from others.

sentences.zh: 檜死，起知婺州，三日被召。

translations.literal: When Hui died, Ciying was raised to govern Wuzhou; within three days he was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: After Hui died, Ciying was raised to govern Wuzhou; within three days he was summoned.

sentences.zh: 至國門，以足疾求去。

translations.literal: Reaching the capital gate, he requested leave citing foot ailment.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching the capital gate, he requested leave citing foot ailment.

sentences.zh: 加秘閣修撰，還郡。

translations.literal: He was given the additional title Compiler of the Secret Archive and returned to his prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He received the additional title Compiler of the Secret Archive and returned to his prefecture.

sentences.zh: 再召見，歷言仇怨當國，老母幾委溝壑，因奏國本未立，上改容曰：「誰可？」

translations.literal: Summoned again, he recounted in detail how enemies and foes held power — his aged mother nearly left to die in ditches — and memorialized that the heir apparent was not yet established. The emperor's expression changed: "Who is suitable?
translations.idiomatic: Summoned again, he recounted in detail how enemies and foes held power — his aged mother nearly left to die in ditches — and memorialized that the heir apparent was not yet established. The emperor's expression changed and he asked, "Who is suitable?"

sentences.zh: 次膺曰：「知子莫若父。」

translations.literal: Ciying said: "No one knows a son like his father.
translations.idiomatic: Ciying said, "No one knows a son like his father."

sentences.zh: 上稱善。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor expressed approval.

sentences.zh: 擢權給事中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to provisional Attendant Drafting Officer.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to acting Attendant Drafting Officer.

sentences.zh: 蔣璨權戶部侍郎，次膺駁璨不守正，事交結，出璨知平江。

translations.literal: When Jiang Can was acting Vice Minister of Revenue, Ciying rejected Can for lack of integrity and cultivating connections, and Can was sent out to govern Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiang Can was acting Vice Minister of Revenue, Ciying blocked his appointment for lack of integrity and cultivating connections, and Can was sent out to govern Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞湯鵬舉劾次膺假權報怨，除待制、宮觀。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Tang Pengju impeached Ciying for using his power to settle scores; he was given the title Attendant Drafting and a palace appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Tang Pengju impeached Ciying for abusing his power to settle scores; he was given the title Attendant Drafting and a palace appointment.

sentences.zh: 起知泉州，移福建帥。

translations.literal: He was raised to govern Quanzhou and transferred to command Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to govern Quanzhou and then transferred to command Fujian.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，乞納祿。

translations.literal: Upon his mother's death he requested to surrender his salary.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he requested to surrender his salary.

sentences.zh: 孝宗即位，手詔趣召。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaozong ascended the throne, he sent a personal edict urgently summoning him.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong took the throne, he sent a personal edict urgently summoning him.

sentences.zh: 既至，奏：「陛下用賢必考核事功，勿以一人譽用之，一人毀去之，出令要無反汗，納善要知轉圜。

translations.literal: Upon arrival he memorialized: "Your Majesty, in employing the worthy you must assess actual achievements — do not appoint on one man's praise or dismiss on one man's slander. Issuing orders must not be reversed; accepting good counsel requires knowing how to change course gracefully.
translations.idiomatic: Upon arrival he memorialized, "Your Majesty, in employing the worthy you must assess actual achievements — do not appoint on one man's praise or dismiss on one man's slander. Issuing orders must not be reversed; accepting good counsel requires knowing how to change course gracefully.

sentences.zh: 練兵恤民，經理兩淮，使敵不能乘虛而入。」

translations.literal: Train troops and care for the people; manage the two Huai regions so the enemy cannot exploit a gap to enter.
translations.idiomatic: Train troops and care for the people; manage the two Huai regions so the enemy cannot exploit a gap to enter."

sentences.zh: 是日，除御史中丞。

translations.literal: That same day he was appointed Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: That same day he was made Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 朝德壽宮，高宗一見，謂：「惜閒卿于強健時。」

translations.literal: Attending at Deshou Palace, Gaozong at one glance said: "A pity that leisure found you only after your vigorous years.
translations.idiomatic: Attending at Deshou Palace, Gaozong at one glance said, "A pity that leisure found you only after your vigorous years."

sentences.zh: 上將以春饗，迎高宗詣延祥觀，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: The emperor planned a spring banquet, welcoming Gaozong to Yansxiang Abbey and visiting Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor planned a spring banquet, welcoming Gaozong to Yansxiang Abbey and then visiting Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 次膺奏：「欽宗服未終，方停策士，且金人嫚書甫至，意在交兵，矧原野間禁衛稀少，當過為之慮，兼一出費十數萬緡，曷若以資兵食。」

translations.literal: Ciying memorialized: "Emperor Qinzong's mourning is not yet complete and the civil examinations have just been suspended. Moreover a Jin insolent letter has just arrived, their intent being to provoke war. Furthermore the forbidden guard is sparse in the open countryside — this should be over-considered. Also a single outing costs more than a hundred thousand strings — why not use it to supply troops' provisions?
translations.idiomatic: Ciying memorialized, "Emperor Qinzong's mourning is not yet complete and the civil examinations have just been suspended. Moreover an insolent Jin letter has just arrived, their intent being to provoke war. Furthermore the palace guard is sparse in the open countryside — this calls for extra caution. Also a single outing costs more than a hundred thousand strings — why not use that to supply troops' provisions?"

sentences.zh: 時兩淮盡為荒野，次膺奏：「乞集遺甿歸業，借種牛，或令在屯兵從便耕種，此足兵良法。」

translations.literal: At the time both Huai regions were entirely wasteland. Ciying memorialized: "I ask that scattered farmers be gathered to return to cultivation, seed and oxen be lent, or garrison troops be allowed to farm as convenient — this is an excellent method to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: At the time both Huai regions were entirely wasteland. Ciying memorialized, "I ask that scattered farmers be gathered to return to cultivation, seed and oxen be lent, or garrison troops be allowed to farm as convenient — this is an excellent method to supply the army."

sentences.zh: 至若成閔之貪饕，湯思退之朋附，葉義問之姦罔，皆以次論劾。

translations.literal: As for Cheng Min's greed, Tang Situi's factional clinging, and Ye Yiwen's treacherous deceit — he impeached them one after another.
translations.idiomatic: He successively impeached Cheng Min for greed, Tang Situi for factional clinging, and Ye Yiwen for treacherous deceit.

sentences.zh: 每章疏一出，天下韙之。

translations.literal: Whenever a memorial appeared, all under heaven applauded it.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever one of his memorials appeared, all under heaven applauded it.

sentences.zh: 上方厲精政事，次膺每以名實為言，多所裨益，呼其官不名。

translations.literal: The emperor was then vigorously managing affairs; Ciying spoke constantly of names and realities and contributed much. The emperor called him by his office title, not his personal name.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was then vigorously managing affairs; Ciying spoke constantly of names and realities and contributed greatly. The emperor addressed him by his office title, not his personal name.

sentences.zh: 隆興改元，三月，同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the third month after the Longxing era change, he became Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the Longxing era change, he became Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 符離之師，捷奏日聞，次膺手疏千言，乞持重。

translations.literal: During the battle at Fuli, daily reports of victory arrived; Ciying submitted a handwritten memorial of a thousand characters asking for restraint.
translations.idiomatic: During the battle at Fuli, daily reports of victory arrived; Ciying submitted a handwritten memorial of a thousand characters urging restraint.

sentences.zh: 未幾，軍果潰。

translations.literal: Before long the army indeed collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the army did indeed collapse.

sentences.zh: 及見，上顏色不樂，奏言：「師潰而歸，張浚彈壓必無他，此上天大儆戒于陛下。」

translations.literal: When he was received, the emperor's face was unhappy. Ciying memorialized: "The army collapsed and returned — Zhang Jun's suppression will surely have no ulterior motive. This is a great warning from Heaven to Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: When he was received, the emperor's face was unhappy. Ciying memorialized, "The army collapsed and returned — Zhang Jun's suppression will surely have no ulterior motive. This is a great warning from Heaven to Your Majesty."

sentences.zh: 上歎其先見。

translations.literal: The emperor sighed at his foresight.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sighed over his foresight.

sentences.zh: 拜參知政事，以疾力祈免。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Grand Councilor but earnestly begged to be excused on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Grand Councilor but earnestly pleaded to be excused on account of illness.

sentences.zh: 且奏曰：「王十朋除侍史，雖上親擢，天下皆知臣嘗薦其賢。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Wang Shipeng was appointed remonstrance official — though the emperor personally selected him, all under heaven know that I once recommended his worth.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized, "Wang Shipeng was appointed remonstrance official — though the emperor personally selected him, all under heaven know that I once recommended his worth.

sentences.zh: 湯思退召將至，亦知臣嘗疏其姦。

translations.literal: Tang Situi is about to be summoned and return; they also know I once memorialized against his treachery.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Situi is about to be summoned back — they also know I once memorialized against his treachery.

sentences.zh: 臣不引避，人其謂何？」

translations.literal: If I do not withdraw, what will people say?
translations.idiomatic: If I do not withdraw, what will people say?"

sentences.zh: 除資政殿學士、提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: He was appointed Academician of the Hall for Aid in Governance and made administrator of Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Academician of the Hall for Aid in Governance and appointed administrator of Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 陛辭，賜茶，甚惜其去。

translations.literal: At his farewell audience tea was bestowed; the emperor greatly regretted his departure.
translations.idiomatic: At his farewell audience the emperor bestowed tea and deeply regretted his departure.

sentences.zh: 次膺奏：「臣與思退，理難同列。」

translations.literal: Ciying memorialized: "Between Situi and myself, reason makes it hard to serve in the same rank.
translations.idiomatic: Ciying memorialized, "Between Situi and myself, reason makes it hard to serve in the same rank."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「有謂湯思退可用者。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Some say Tang Situi can be employed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Some say Tang Situi can be employed."

sentences.zh: 次膺奏：「今日之事，恐非思退能辨。

translations.literal: Ciying memorialized: "Today's affairs — I fear Situi cannot distinguish them.
translations.idiomatic: Ciying memorialized, "Today's affairs — I fear Situi cannot distinguish them.

sentences.zh: 思退固不足道，竊恐誤國家事。」

translations.literal: Situi is scarcely worth mentioning, but I privately fear he will harm state and family affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Situi is scarcely worth mentioning, but I privately fear he will harm state and family affairs."

sentences.zh: 乾道六年閏五月卒，年七十九。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month of the sixth year of Qiandao he died, aged seventy-nine.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the intercalary fifth month of the sixth year of the Qiandao era, aged seventy-nine.

sentences.zh: 次膺孝友清介，立朝謇諤。

translations.literal: Ciying was filial and friendly, pure and upright; at court he spoke bluntly.
translations.idiomatic: Ciying was filial and friendly, pure and upright, and at court spoke with blunt integrity.

sentences.zh: 仕宦五十年，無絲毫挂吏議。

translations.literal: In fifty years of official service he had not the slightest mark against him in censorial records.
translations.idiomatic: In fifty years of official service he bore not the slightest mark in censorial records.

sentences.zh: 為政貴清靜，先德化，所至人稱其不煩。

translations.literal: In governing he valued tranquility, putting moral transformation first; wherever he went people praised that he was not burdensome.
translations.idiomatic: In governing he valued tranquility and put moral transformation first; wherever he went people praised that he was not burdensome.

sentences.zh: 善屬文，尤工於詩。

translations.literal: He was skilled at literary composition, especially adept at poetry.
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled at literary composition and especially adept at poetry.

sentences.zh: 論曰：孝宗志恢復，特任張浚，俊卿斥姦黨，明公道，以為之佐。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Xiaozong aspired to recovery and specially entrusted Zhang Jun; Junqing expelled the faction of the wicked and clarified public principle to assist him.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Emperor Xiaozong aspired to recovery and specially entrusted Zhang Jun; Junqing expelled the faction of the wicked and clarified public principle to assist him.

sentences.zh: 洎居中書，知無不為，言無不盡，蓋其立志一以先哲為法，非他相可擬也。

translations.literal: When he reached the Secretariat, there was nothing he would not do and nothing he would not say — because he had set his aspiration entirely by the ancient sages as model, not to be compared with other chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached the Secretariat, there was nothing he would not undertake and nothing he would not speak — for he had set his aspiration entirely by the ancient sages as model, not to be compared with other chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 允文許國之忠，炳如丹青。

translations.literal: Yunwen's loyalty in serving the state shone like figures in red and green.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen's loyalty in serving the state shone as brightly as figures painted in red and green.

sentences.zh: 金庶人亮之南侵，其鋒甚銳，中外倚劉錡為長城，錡以病不克進師。

translations.literal: When the Jin commoner Liang invaded south, his momentum was very sharp; court and country relied on Liu Qi as a great wall, but Qi because of illness could not advance his army.
translations.idiomatic: When the deposed Jin ruler Liang invaded south, his momentum was very sharp; court and country relied on Liu Qi as a great wall, but Qi because of illness could not advance his army.

sentences.zh: 允文儒臣，奮勇督戰，一舉而挫之，亮乃自斃。

translations.literal: Yunwen, a civil minister, roused courage to direct battle, and in one stroke broke them; Liang then died by his own hand.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen, a civil minister, roused courage to direct the battle, and in one stroke broke the enemy; Liang then died by his own hand.

sentences.zh: 昔赤壁一勝而三國勢成，淮淝一勝而南北勢定。

translations.literal: Formerly one victory at Red Cliffs fixed the tripartite balance; one victory at Fei River fixed the balance between north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly one victory at Red Cliffs fixed the tripartite balance; one victory on the Huai and at Fei River fixed the balance between north and south.

sentences.zh: 允文采石之功，宋事轉危為安，實係乎此。

translations.literal: Yunwen's achievement at Caishi turned Song's peril into safety — it truly hinged on this.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen's achievement at Caishi turned the Song peril into safety — the dynasty truly hinged on this.

sentences.zh: 及其罷相鎮蜀，受命興復，克期而往，志雖未就，其能慷慨任重，豈易得哉？

translations.literal: When he was dismissed as chief minister and stationed in Shu, ordered to recover lost territory and setting a deadline to go — though his aim was not fulfilled, that he could be magnanimous and bear heavy responsibility — is that easily found?
translations.idiomatic: When he was dismissed as chief minister and stationed in Shu, ordered to recover lost territory and setting a deadline to march — though his aim was not fulfilled, that he could be magnanimous and bear heavy responsibility — is that easily found?

sentences.zh: 次膺力排群邪，無負言責，涖政不煩，居約有守。

translations.literal: Ciying forcefully expelled the multitude of wicked men, did not fail in the duty of remonstrance, governed without harassment, and in poverty kept his integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Ciying forcefully expelled the multitude of wicked men, did not fail in the duty of remonstrance, governed without vexation, and in poverty kept his integrity.

sentences.zh: 晚再立朝，謇諤尤著，南渡直言之臣，宜為首稱焉。

translations.literal: Late in life he again stood at court, his blunt speaking especially notable — among the remonstrance ministers since the southern crossing, he should be ranked first.
translations.idiomatic: Late in life he again stood at court, his blunt speaking especially notable — among the outspoken ministers since the southern crossing, he should be ranked first.
